transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Hello doctor, how are you?

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: I'm good, what about you?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Ah, yeah, I am fine, but I am feeling dizzy and weakness from past 2 days, doctor.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Why, what happened? Where did you went?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I went to uh I went to out of station where I had a lot of stuff and foods uh outside food. Like I don't know what happened, I was little I was much tired while walking outside. I don't know what is happening, but I am feeling very tired these days and I'm unable to eat properly. I'm unable to take proper health, proper uh intake of food.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Oh okay. Did you had any Did you had any difficulty in breathing?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yeah doctor, I am having difficulty breathing also.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, it's because of weather change, no need to worry. I'll prescribe some antibiotics right now. Uh take it after having lunch, and also make sure to have proper diet and make sure to have proper sleep. We'll follow up in next 2 days if you're feeling dizzy after taking these medicines, if your fever persist again. Okay?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Okay doctor, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Thank you.

summary.chief_complaint: Feeling dizzy and weak for the past 2 days.
summary.consultation_overview: Patient presented with weakness, dizziness, fatigue, poor food intake, and breathing difficulty after returning from out of station. The doctor attributed symptoms to a weather change and prescribed antibiotics along with dietary and rest recommendations.
symptoms: Poor appetite / inability to eat properly
summary.history_of_present_illness: Patient reports onset of dizziness, weakness, and fatigue for 2 days following a trip out of station where she consumed outside food. She experiences tiredness while walking outside, is unable to eat properly, and reports difficulty breathing.
summary.treatment_plan: Prescription of antibiotics to be taken after lunch, accompanied by lifestyle advice regarding diet and sleep. Follow-up scheduled in 2 days.
summary.follow_up: Follow up in 2 days if dizziness persists after taking medicines or if fever persists.
